overall_summary: Data volume is low across the channel, but videos centered around 'self respect' with micro-actions involving phone interfaces (deleting chats, clearing lists, ignoring notifications) outperform generic romantic or philosophical hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Self Respect Status Story' (rwOUYo_hayQ, 41 views) and 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (AfaLxMy6FMY, 41 views) perform better than abstract emotional topics.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks around specific, tactile smartphone actions related to letting go.

winning_patterns.evidence: View counts skew higher (30-40+ range) when the narrative shifts from helplessness (overthinking, waiting) to reclaiming dignity (blocking, removing, muting).
winning_patterns.action: Prioritize 'self respect' sub-topics over passive sorrow.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc, 13 views) and 'अधूरी उम्मीद' (WhJ-VwRa3Rg, 8 views) show weaker pull compared to active self-respect choices.
weak_patterns.action: Reduce broad late-night melancholic setups unless tied to a definitive boundary-setting action.
